# Auto-Generated Parsers

The parsers in this directory are automatically generated from the [Kaitai Struct format gallery](https://formats.kaitai.io/). They are regenerated by [`build_backend.py`](../../../build_backend.py) whenever a wheel, a source distribution, or an editable install is built from a source checkout, and therefore **THESE FILES SHOULD NOT BE EDITED**. A build from a source distribution reuses the parsers that the distribution already carries.
